```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(bib2df)
library(flextable)
library(lingglosses)
options("lingglosses.italic_transliteration" = FALSE)

read_tsv("bibliography.tsv") |> 
  distinct() |> 
  df2bib(file = "bibliography.bib")
```

# СПИСОК ИСПОЛНИТЕЛЕЙ {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Руководитель темы:

```{r}
read_csv("data/people_head.csv", na = "NA") |>  
  mutate_all(function(i){ifelse(is.na(i), "", i)}) |> 
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE,
                  table.align = "left") |>
  gt::opt_table_lines(extent = "none") 
```

Исполнители:

```{r}
read_csv("data/people.csv", na = "NA") |>
  mutate_all(function(i){ifelse(is.na(i), "", i)}) |> 
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE,
                  table.align = "left") |>
  gt::opt_table_lines(extent = "none") 
```
